name: read_file_code
description: Read one file of the private codebase and return its text. The path is relative to the repository root, exactly as a search_code result prints it, and is case-sensitive. The response is capped: concise returns the first 4,000 characters, detailed the first 20,000, and a cut file ends with a note saying how many characters were shown and how many exist. An empty file returns '[empty file]'. A path that does not exist, is in config/, or is not a text file is an error that names the path, never an empty result; for a path that does not exist, the error also lists files with near-miss names.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root, copied from a search_code result, such as src/util/money.ts. Case-sensitive: src/reports.ts is not src/Report.ts. Reading costs tokens in proportion to the length returned, so read only files a search or the issue pointed to.

response_format.description: concise: the first 4,000 characters; the cheap choice, use it first. detailed: up to 20,000 characters; use it only when a concise read ended with a truncation note and you need the rest.

examples.note: typical: a path copied from a search result, cheap format
hard: paths are exact and case-sensitive, so src/Report.ts, src/reports.ts and src/report.tsx are three different files
